{{Top|leg}}
The '''Alliance Target List''' was an approved listing of companies and organizations that the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] considered to be legitimate targets for [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]] activity. The list included military, corporate, and private organizations who contributed to, and supported, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="PP">''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''</ref>
